All options specific to device `epsonds:net:192.168.0.167':
  Standard:
    --source ADF Front|ADF Duplex [ADF Front]
        Selects the scan source (such as a document-feeder).
    --mode Lineart|Gray|Color [Color]
        Selects the scan mode (e.g., lineart, monochrome, or color).
    --depth 1|8bit [8]
        Number of bits per sample, typical values are 1 for "line-art" and 8
        for multibit scans.
    --resolution 50|75|100|150|200|240|300|360|400|600dpi [50]
        Sets the resolution of the scanned image.
  Geometry:
    -l 0..215.9mm [0]
        Top-left x position of scan area.
    -t 0..393.7mm [0]
        Top-left y position of scan area.
    -x 0..215.9mm [215.9]
        Width of scan-area.
    -y 0..393.7mm [393.7]
        Height of scan-area.
  Optional equipment:
    --eject []
        Eject the sheet in the ADF
    --load [inactive]
        Load a sheet in the ADF
    --adf-skew[=(yes|no)] [no]
        Enables ADF skew correction
    --adf-crp[=(yes|no)] [no]
        Enables ADF auto cropping
